#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate portside/generated/registry.py from registry/*.csv.

  python3 tools/gen.py                 write it
  python3 tools/gen.py --check         fail if it is out of date
  python3 tools/gen.py --root DIR      work on another checkout
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

OUT = "portside/generated/registry.py"


def parse(text):
    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(",")]
    rows = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split(",")]
        cells += [""] * (len(header) - len(cells))
        rows[cells[0].upper()] = {h: (int(v) if v.isdigit() else v) for h, v in zip(header, cells) if h != "code"}
    return rows


def render(root):
    out = ["# Generated by tools/gen.py from registry/*.csv. Do not edit by hand.", "", "TABLES = {"]
    for path in sorted((Path(root) / "registry").glob("*.csv")):
        rows = parse(path.read_text())
        out.append(f"    {path.stem!r}: {{")
        for code in sorted(rows):
            fields = ", ".join(f"{k!r}: {rows[code][k]!r}" for k in sorted(rows[code]))
            out.append(f"        {code!r}: {{{fields}}},")
        out.append("    },")
    out += ["}", ""]
    return "\n".join(out)


def main(argv):
    root = Path(argv[argv.index("--root") + 1]) if "--root" in argv else Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    text = render(root)
    target = root / OUT
    if "--check" in argv:
        if not target.exists() or target.read_text() != text:
            print(f"error: {OUT} is out of date with registry/*.csv, run 'make gen'", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        return 0
    target.write_text(text)
    print(f"wrote {OUT}")
    return 0
